name: ntc_10k_divider
label: NTC 10k thermistor in a voltage divider
description:
A 10 kOhm NTC (B = 3950 K, 10 kOhm at 25 °C) from the ADC input to ground, with a 10 kOhm
resistor from 3.3 V to the input: the pod puts out the voltage the DUT's ADC would see. Copy
the file and change the constants for another divider (a pull-down instead of a pull-up: swap
the two resistances in `value`).
